subcategory_text: Impacted individuals and organizations are notified about a privacy breach or event.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AU-6, IR-6 (Incident Reporting), IR-4 (Incident Handling)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.24 (Information security incident management planning)
GDPR Art. 33 (Notification to supervisory authority), Art. 34 (Communication to data subject)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 RS.MA-01 (incident management plan)
implementation_examples: Define a breach/privacy-event communication process with role assignments, content templates, regulator notification timelines, and individual notification triggers
Test the communication processes via tabletop and live exercises
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a privacy-event notification process exists
Determine whether templates and timelines are documented
Determine whether notification tests are held
Determine whether notification artefacts are preserved
